key: MURMINA: First Agate and now this...
en: MURMINA: First Agate and now this...
ja: ムルミナ: アゲートに続いて、今度はこれか……

key: I don't want to be next--
en: I don't want to be next--
ja: 次はあたしの番なんて、嫌――

key: I'm going to hide somewhere else!
en: I'm going to hide somewhere else!

ja: キャロラインの部屋、あそこの――

key: Yeah, no one who hasn't seen the basement key should be able to open it...
en: Yeah, no one who hasn't seen the basement key should be able to open it...
ja: そうだ、地下の鍵を見たことない奴には開けられないはず……
絶対についてくるんじゃないわよ!
